hook_candidates.headline: Your inbox slows you down.
hook_candidates.sub: Google published a small business case study on November 19, 2026 about Gemini email.

caption:
Gemini sits inside Gmail now. You can use it to draft routine replies without typing them. This saves time on client follow-ups and scheduling. Gemini isn't magic. It can hallucinate details or miss your tone if you do not check the draft. Always review emails before sending. It works best for standard messages, not complex negotiations.

To try this: Open Gmail. Click the Gemini button in the compose window. Paste this prompt:

"Draft a polite reply to this client email. Confirm the meeting time is Tuesday at 2pm. Ask if they need a dial-in link. Keep it under 50 words."

Visit the Google Workspace AI resources page to see training. Small business owners are already using this to handle inbox volume.

Save this for your next client follow-up.
